title: The Sharp Border
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Mirabel Dravenmoor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
